description: EXPLORE REGISTRY EVIDENCE for a condition (formerly simulate_twin; that name still works as an alias). It simulates nothing about a patient. Returns descriptive counts and alphabetical candidate examples, not efficacy or a treatment sequence. score and plausibility are null. NEXT: twin_experiment_guide and run_twin_experiment for explicit reaction-model simulation, or post_reality_request to obtain measurements.

condition.description: The condition to model, e.g. glioblastoma.

examples.description: How many alphabetical candidate examples to return, 1 to 3 (default 3).

name: explore_condition_registry

_meta.description: source, generatedAt, sources (per-source lastSyncedAt and ageHours), rateLimit, disclaimer.

data.description: The answer. Shape depends on the tool; describe_tool documents it.
